title: AudioOverImage Producer
overview: A production-grade, ultra-performant content generation desktop engine designed for podcast producers, musicians, and audio creators. It merges audio streams (podcasts, music, voiceovers) with static or animated background images and dynamic real-time audio waveform/spectrum visualizers. Employs zero-waste FFmpeg stream looping, zero-copy buffer pipes, NumPy audio spectrum analysis, Pillow image compositing, and a real-time Tkinter preview canvas, delivering YouTube/Shorts/TikTok-ready MP4 output.
key_features: WYSIWYG Live Canvas Preview: Interactive viewport with aspect ratio bounding boxes, waveform position dragging, and background scaling preview
Multi-Aspect Ratio Presets: YouTube 16:9 (1920x1080 / 3840x2160 4K), YouTube Shorts/TikTok 9:16 (1080x1920), Instagram Square 1:1 (1080x1080), and Ultrawide 21:9 (2560x1080)
Advanced Background Processing Modes: Cover (Crop to fit), Contain (Pillarbox/Letterbox), Stretch, and Dual-Layer Gaussian Blur Padding
Dynamic Waveform & Spectrum Visualizer Engine: Customizable render modes (Line Waveform, Solid Bars, Circular Spectrum, Audio Frequency Histogram) with real-time color gradient controls
Automatic Audio Sync & Metadata Extraction: High-precision FFprobe duration probing down to fractional millisecond values
Hardware-Accelerated Encoder Auto-Detection: NVENC (NVIDIA), QSV (Intel), and AMF (AMD) with automated software CPU (libx264) fallback
Non-Blocking Asynchronous Processing: Thread-safe queue architecture for continuous stderr progress telemetry parsing, rendering ETA calculation, and instant process cancellation

core_stack.image_processing: Pillow (PIL) >= 10.0.0 (High-quality Lanczos resampling, blurring, composite rendering)
core_stack.math_and_audio: NumPy >= 1.24.0 (Vectorized RMS calculation, frequency FFT binning, normalized amplitude matrices)

system_architecture.pattern: Model-View-Controller (MVC) with Asynchronous Thread-Safe Event Queue
system_architecture.main_ui_thread: CustomTkinter 60 FPS loop managing UI events, live canvas updates, user controls, and polling event queues every 40ms
system_architecture.worker_threads: Background Python threads executing non-blocking stream & engine tasks
system_architecture.inter_thread_communication: Thread-safe queue.Queue passing typed telemetry payloads: ('PROGRESS', percent, frame, time, fps, eta), ('CANVAS_FRAME', PIL_Image), ('LOG', text), ('COMPLETE', output_path), ('ERROR', err_str)
system_architecture.process_safety: Thread-safe event queue passing, clean process tree termination, and memory safety
system_architecture.ui_thread: CustomTkinter main loop polling queue.Queue every 40ms for 60 FPS UI responsiveness

binary_resolution_order: User interactive manual binary file selection dialog
ai_agent_prompt:
You are an elite Senior Desktop Media Systems & UI Engineer tasked with implementing a production-grade Windows desktop application titled 'AudioOverImage Producer'.

### PROJECT OBJECTIVE:
Construct a zero-cpu-waste content creation utility that merges audio tracks (podcasts, songs, voiceovers) with static or processed background images and real-time audio waveform/spectrum visualizations to output social-media-ready MP4 videos.

### MANDATORY TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. DISTINCT UI & THEME (STUDIO EMERALD & CYBER SLATE):
   - Implement a dark-mode studio theme using #0A0E14 (Background), #131B26 (Sidebar/Panels), #00E676 (Primary Neon Emerald Accent), and #1DE9B6 (Teal Secondary Accent).
   - Responsive layout featuring a left control sidebar, central WYSIWYG image canvas preview with aspect ratio guides, render controls footer, and collapsible terminal log.

2. WYSIWYG LIVE CANVAS PREVIEW ENGINE:
   - Build a real-time Tkinter Canvas component that scales image inputs according to selected aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 21:9) and scaling modes (Cover, Contain with custom padding, Blur Fill).
   - Render interactive visual overlay bounding boxes allowing users to visually reposition the audio waveform overlay.

3. FFMPEG ZERO-WASTE TRANSCODING ENGINE:
   - Construct high-performance FFmpeg filtergraphs using -loop 1 with -tune stillimage and -shortest flags to eliminate repetitive re-encoding overhead.
   - Dynamically build complex filtergraphs (filter_complex) for showwaves (waveform lines/bars) and showfreqs (frequency spectrum) overlays with customizable colors, opacity, and positioning.

4. HARDWARE ACCELERATION & BINARY AUTO-RESOLVER:
   - Auto-detect GPU hardware acceleration (h264_nvenc, h264_qsv, h264_amf) with smooth fallback to software CPU (libx264).
   - Implement a 4-tier binary lookup hierarchy (sys._MEIPASS -> local script dir -> ./bin/ -> system PATH).

5. ASYNCHRONOUS TELEMETRY & CONCURRENCY:
   - Never block the UI thread. Use worker threads (threading.Thread) and a thread-safe queue.Queue polled every 40ms by root.after().
   - Intercept FFmpeg stderr stream line-by-line via regex to extract timestamp, total duration, rendering FPS, speed factor, and calculate percentage completion: Progress % = (Current Seconds / Total Seconds) * 100.

6. RESILIENCE, CLEANUP & PACKAGING:
   - Handle job cancellations safely by sending process group termination signals (taskkill /F /T /PID) and automatically cleaning up partial temporary files.
   - Provide a complete AudioOverImageProducer.spec file for PyInstaller packaging into a single executable.
